# Compatibility matrix: SIE v0.10.1

<!-- Generated by tools/ci/compatibility_matrix.py from docs/compatibility/sie-compatibility-v0.10.1.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each cell is one model profile in one published image lane. A `tested` cell passed a GPU smoke test of that lane's exact image digest. A `declared` cell is routed to the lane and nothing excludes it, but no smoke test of that image backs it. An `unsupported` cell is excluded by the rule its reason names.

Cells: 326 tested, 261 declared, 54 unsupported.

## NVIDIA driver floors

The minimum NVIDIA Linux driver for each CUDA major version under CUDA minor version compatibility, as NVIDIA documents it. A newer driver also runs older CUDA versions through backward compatibility. Minor version compatibility has documented limits: PTX that the driver must JIT-compile needs the driver of the toolkit that produced it, and some features span the toolkit and the driver.

| CUDA | Minimum Linux driver | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12.x | >= 525 | [NVIDIA](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html) |
| 13.x | >= 580 | [NVIDIA](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/cuda-compatibility/minor-version-compatibility.html) |
